scientific_role: held-out curved bow-shock geometry and vortex false-positive control

physics.reynolds_note: Euler has no viscosity and no finite Reynolds-number parameter. Do not report this case as Re=1e4--1e5.
physics.vortex_note: No viscous vortex-shedding ground truth is claimed. Vorticity output is retained only to audit neural false positives.

leakage_policy: All saved states from one Mach/grid run form one indivisible case group.
validation_observables: bow-shock centerline standoff distance divided by cylinder diameter
surface pressure coefficient versus polar angle
density and pressure jumps on the stagnation streamline
post-shock Mach number on the stagnation streamline
late-time stationarity of the shock locus
absence of accepted shock pixels on the immersed boundary

references.citation: Experimental Studies of Supersonic Flow past a Circular Cylinder, Journal of the Physical Society of Japan 11 (1956) 439

acceptance_gates.raw_state: finite positive density and pressure outside the body
acceptance_gates.numerical_convergence: f180-to-f270 change below 1% for standoff and below 2% for the near-nose shock curve after common-grid projection
acceptance_gates.normal_shock_verification: one-sided stagnation-line jumps compared with the exact reference, with sampling offsets and numerical shock width reported
acceptance_gates.experimental_validation: agreement reported with the digitized experimental uncertainty; no validation claim before experimental curves are digitized and compared
acceptance_gates.ml_reporting: shock centerline/envelope and background/other are scored; vortex output is a false-positive count, not a positive target
